TOLOSAKO INMAKULADA LANBIDE IKASTOLA (TILI) is a private chartered Middle and Higher Vocational Training Center within the Association of Basque Schools (EHI). TILI is an organization with a Basque character and its work is based on cooperative education. For its management, it accepts the principles of Total Quality and Excellence and is committed to continuous improvement and compliance with the requirements set by law.
